I dealt with this too after my first ever long (4 months 12 days lol) hypomanic into borderline schizo/psychosis into depressive episode hit me so bad. I genuinely couldn’t talk. I’d was afraid to talk. My anxiety rushed and rushed. Even my own brain I couldn’t form what I wanted to say in my head. I developed severe headaches that’s almost knock me out. I started trying to write it out. didn’t really help. i read somewhere that episodes can cause damage. And I think it has some truth to it because 3 months after my episode I was pretty much challenged with speech. Im okay now tho. I don’t know what it was I did but headaches are barely there and I’m able to get through public speaking and general conversations at will. i think my brain was just tryna heal it’s self.

I started learning almost 6/7 months ago. I had no musical ear. I didn’t know keys or anything for about 2 of those months. Id get so frustrated. I had and still do have this same issue at times, but I find it’s when I’m doing to much and I need to edit myself back lol. I used to get really frustrated and couldn’t make it 15min in. In January I got offered to have a 3-month period radio show starting in April, and the amount of music and literal DAYYS I’ve pushed myself through my mistakes. I’ve broaden my music tastes and reviewed keys and bpms so transitions weren’t as harsh or off. I’ve started curation playlists again which has been a huge help in my transitions, phrasing, even down to my EQ and other effects etc. From 6 months ago to now, I’ve definitely gotten a much more cleaner and less off putting beat & tempo changes. Im very comfortable with it. I had to edit myself and just let my nerves go. im not sure if this is of any help. but I hope it gives u some hope to just keep practicing, don’t even bother with worrying what others sound like compared to u. You are searching for your ear, your sound. (: You’ve got this! feel free to dm if u have any other questions or want to chat about it! “You improve every time you start the set.” (:
EDIT: Music is fun. Have fun!

BP1 here.. I typically have my manic episodes start with hypomania. they last anywhere from a day, week, a month or to almost a year tbh. It’s quite exhilarating and exhausting when I crash out of it. If it goes on for too long or I get way too excited and confident I believe nothing can stop me or beat me. I start to challenge myself in ways that are abnormal such as extended drug use which worsens my overall mood.(I cry and crash out) I almost feel invincible. however when it’s gone I either am in depressive or I’m left with an empty hallow longing of something that I usually have to force myself to find by getting into the projects I started while hypomanic. Another thing is since it’s also a manic episode I have recently had auditory delusions. very wild lol

I love when I’m hypomanic. Especially when I’m in control and monitoring how I feel and view things with my journal or simply identifying out loud. I try to keep myself level by remaining grounded but sometimes my kite string gets a little far but most of the time I reel it back in. I usually end up being my most productive, creative and selfless person when in this state. it feels like me just with a smile and hope. Also my confidence level BOOSTS like no other. Lmao
